positions.name: ProbeCarriesReviewerEnrollmentAssertion
positions.frame: what does this probe memory exist to assert about reviewer enrollment on save?
positions.why: Both expressions read as a single instrumental unit: src-1 states the e2e-suite assertion (creator enrolled as reviewer on save) in flat, unhedged, present-tense claim form, and src-2 immediately declares that this very memory's sole reason for existing is to carry that assertion. The directional observations reinforce a shared read — same matter-of-fact/instrumental register (mint-1 names this for src-2, and src-1's plain technical assertion shares it), same claim-level conviction (not yet ratified/operationalized), same present/realis/concrete temporal footing, and the same authority-ranking relational frame (the system enrolls by rank; the probe memory is subordinate vehicle for that rule). No tension between the two — src-2 explicitly subordinates itself to src-1's content, so the group coheres as one self-declared probe artifact rather than two independent claims.
